notes.title: HERE’S THE NUCVIVOR WITH A MAJOR UPDATE !
notes.content:
Hello dear players !

As Team & Target team we are proud of announcing this great update.
We received lots of positive and negative feedback about Nucvivor. Thanks for your precious reviews. You’re the most important part of this update. Since the beginning of the Nucvivor we have thought that players must direct the game with their feedbacks. You did it.
Let’s look at the update journal about most frequent negative feedback we’ve got.

[h1]Graphics and Lighting;[/h1]
In the old version of Nucvivor, you had gloomy and dark world. We had some problems about lighting. Your feedbacks made us solve that problem. We did serious research about lighting and some model textures were redraw. Eventually we have the realistic results of our work  and you can see in this update.

[b][h1]BEFORE[/h1][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34260873/2d944c88e13fbcbe3c1fcaaab6763fa16cbc46d2.png[/img]

[h1][b]AFTER[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34260873/a858bd895e52bdaf50842b5c9dab63dc2d6455e7.png[/img]

[b][h1]BEFORE[/h1][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34260873/bd8f5b166f14aef9fa220f9b586173370f609535.png[/img]

[h1][b]AFTER[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34260873/f153b3e78c28efed31205782ed0b891bb6c82cac.png[/img]

The graphically difference you can see in our page is just a click away!

[h1]Interface;[/h1]
:radioactive: We went through many changes about the interface before but none of them was good as now.We created more modern,classic and functional interface. 
:radioactive:The biggest problem with the old interface was that everything was so big and there were no color harmony. This was a aesthetical problem.

[h1][b]OLD VERSION OF INVENTORY[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34260873/d54f3429d669bfdf8335455a344c3b00634b13a1.png[/img]

[h1][b]NEW VERSION[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34260873/fecbf5cb29db69f1dd8a4f32b99de9960d25c725.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34260873/8503ed557061c8ce8eb32d38c1305e3339660ff1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34260873/37c60d16a300028979bc30df23404542a44b1e85.png[/img]

:radioactive:One another problem was the small pictures of the objects.There were lots of pictures which don’t fits the game.This problem solved with redraw of all pictures.
:radioactive:Indicators of hunger,thirst etc. Are redraw.
Guide Book
We had difficulty to explain Nucvivor. We’ve added the guide book as a solution.You can open the guide book by pressing ‘’F1!’’.


[h1]Changes made and resolved bugs in brief.[/h1]

:radioactive:Gravity is more realistic.
:radioactive:An error about the capacity of bag is fixed.
:radioactive:Radioactive storm is removed.
:radioactive:Grass in houses is removed.
:radioactive:Loading screens are changed.
:radioactive:Critical errors about saving are fixed
:radioactive:Death screen is removed.Now you’ll see an animation when you die.
:radioactive:When your health decreases,you’ll understand it better with a new animation.
:radioactive:New roads are added in map.
:radioactive:All models redrawn.
:radioactive:Inventory panel redrawn.
:radioactive:Indicator panels redrawn.
:radioactive:Main menu redrawn.
:radioactive:Menu in game redrawn.
:radioactive:Character panel redrawn.
:radioactive:Self improvment panel redrawn.
:radioactive:Building panel redrawn.
:radioactive:All pictures of objects redrawn.
:radioactive:Furnace panel redrawn.
:radioactive:Sleeping panel redrawn and detailed.
:radioactive:Tree models are changed.
:radioactive:Less grass,more optimization.
:radioactive:Some work had done for optimization.
:radioactive:Soundtracks of Nucvivor is being used effectively now.(Thanks for Reptique ) 
:radioactive:A dam has been added to the map.
:radioactive:An error about falling down from the map is fixed.
:radioactive:The border of the map red zone is removed.
:radioactive:The sounds are improved
:radioactive:The mist is more realistic now.
:radioactive:Sticks are collectible like Stones.
:radioactive:Logical errors about crafting are fixed.
:radioactive:An error about melting irons in furnace is fixed.
:radioactive:Some graphical tips about time are added while using furnace.
:radioactive:You’ll see on the furnace panel how long furnace going to be on a fire.
:radioactive:Atatürk Power Plant is removed but his light continues to illuminate our way.

That’s the all brief information about our game.We hope you’ll find your return of your feedbacks as you like.

See you in another update journal !

notes.title: Nucvivor | Early Access Update 0.02
notes.content:
[b]  This is the first important update for the early access.Four important updates are on the way.Vital errors about saving system is fixed and Nucvivor has a gameplay time about five hours.[/b]


+The error about starting the game with same settings is fixed.
+Mouse control problem in the death screen is fixed.

[i]Camp fire could hurt you but you couldn't get a proper sound and it is fixed.[/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34260873/97ca461968681c1ea8a77ff5d70ebca436c8500d.png[/img]

+Brightness settings is fixed.

[i]Now you can see the water level in the water collector and it has 3d text.
[/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34260873/425bb5f51fc275e782508c9ec2465f2f3d8c0fcf.jpg[/img]

+Campfire sounds better now.

[i]The problem about furnace is fixed.[/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34260873/49cb0094ceb776a02e591ef6055011f7c3c7009a.jpg[/img]

[i]Now you can sleep on the beds you can craft.[/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34260873/36c11df15c6910c66d3c1cb6f33ef37e020b46db.jpg[/img]

+Flashlight is added.

[i]You can open the game guide by pressing f1 or you can see on the menu.You can see the basic game mechanics on the game guide.[/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34260873/8f062340756117ebf2d74d246b1ba09bfdd816fa.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34260873/04c52436fea9a9d0c814f390b7c8cfc789797ad4.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34260873/854c36c52964a31265adf3a8b5324e3ce460fbe7.jpg[/img]

[b](Note: In order to save the game you should sleep.Everytime you open the game you can click on the continue button.)[/b]

notes.title: Nucvivor | Early Access Update 0.01
notes.content:
Hello dear players !

This update will bring some new features to the game.

Fixed bugs :

+Thumbnail of the radiation drug fixed.
+Indicator of the need of water is fixed.
+An error about time limit of the gas mask is fixed.
+An error about the plastic bags which is dropped is fixed.
+The sound of loss of health is fixed.
+The error about inventory part of the some bags you found is fixed.
+You couldn't take the items with shift + lmb.Now you can.
+The algorithmic problem about the axe and the watch which you take in left hand is fixed.
+The items which you take from the bag was causing a copying problem.It is fixed.
+When you entered the options the buttons were disappearing.This error is fixed.
+An error about the graphic settings on the launcher is fixed.


New loot area !

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34260873/97ca461968681c1ea8a77ff5d70ebca436c8500d.png[/img]

Have you ever been in festivals in summer ? The feeling of festivals is now on nucvivor !
This area was a place which was used by a couple of friends before the war.Now it's empty but you can use for shelter.
